keys.swarm.aura_iron_bulwark_desc: Your shield plates form a wall in front of you, charge out to bulldoze the monsters ahead and block enemy bolts, then swing back.
keys.swarm.aura_iron_bulwark_ten: The Citadel: four walls slam out in every direction and hold as a square fort round you.
keys.swarm.aura_quake_step_desc: Every few steps a crack shoots forward along the ground and forks, hitting what is in its path.
keys.swarm.aura_quake_step_ten: Fault Line: one fissure tears right across the screen.
